$comment: S0014 P2: the forbidden terms of this product's promotion. Held by tools/promotion/assert-promotion.ps1. `published` entries bind every published source (README, the ledger, the positioning source, the Play listing source, the privacy policies, the portal sections, the help sources, every string resource, the site pages); `fields` entries bind only the discoverability fields - a topic, a search term, the Play title and the short description - and not the full description. Two classes (S0014 decision 3): the piracy-signal class, and the names of other products (owner, 2026-10-09: no competitor name in anything published). A bundled component credited in the notices and the platform names (Android, Wear OS, Google Play, GitHub) are not competitor names and are not listed. The names come from the internal research notes in PLAN/S0014_free-promotion-campaign/research/ and from the Windows sibling's list (SP-0039). This file is the one place the names are written; it is never a published source. A term retired here is fixed in every published source in the same edit.
